title: Claude + Google Omni Edits All My Videos!
description:
I don't edit my videos anymore.

I upload the raw clip and Claude edits the whole thing for me.

I don't even write the prompts. Claude reads the footage, decides what each moment needs, writes the effect instructions itself, and sends them to Google Omni to do the VFX.

Everything in the bottom video was added that way, right down to the insane bottle trick. I just watch the results and approve the edit.

Grab the Omni Video Director here 👇🏻
https://dainami.ai/go/omni-yt

Prefer a DM? Follow me on Instagram and comment "OMNI" and I'll send it over.

#ai #claudecode #googleomni #aivideoediting #aitools
